$comment: The policy for the HAND-WRITTEN half of the docs (scripts/docs-check.mjs, passes two and three). Generated blocks are derived from the code and cannot lie about it; these claims watch what a person typed. Every entry carries its why, because a claim without a reason is a style opinion wearing a security badge. The named limit, from voicebox-beads-f0b and kept honest here: a denylist catches RETIREMENT, not ROT — a sentence can become false without using a forbidden word. These passes are progress, not coverage.

forbid.why: retired refusal wording (voicebox-beads-f0b): containment refuses by name, and the phrase that landed names the active project root. Survives only in docs/evidence receipts, which are history and outside the covered documents.

retired claim (voicebox-beads-mo9's founding rot): the audio path IS live over /live to models/gemini-3.8-live; the TURN path is the scripted resolver. A doc saying 'nothing calls Gemini Live' flattens the two halves into one false sentence.

require.why: the README must keep naming the real capture path — mic in, /live, models/gemini-3.8-live with thinking — and must never fall back to advertising browser dictation as the product route.
the single-host rule: the server binds 127.0.0.1, and serving on 0.0.0.0 is a different product (docs/08-how-it-runs.md).
the architecture doc must keep naming the root seam it is built on — an architecture doc that loses its foundation path has drifted from the tree it describes.
